caption:
One of my favorite edits I’ve worked on recently👀 

For this one, I mixed paper & fabric textures with vintage digital elements inspired by the 1900s. 

A style that’s been trending in 2026, but also felt perfect for the warm, personal vibe of this video.

The client wanted something dynamic, fresh, and different, so I experimented a little… and they loved the result :)

Sometimes the best edits come from mixing styles you wouldn’t normally put together.

Would you try this style for your content?
